messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Furoscix can be used in adults and in children weighing 43 kg or more.
the Furoscix On-Body Infusor, a wearable device that delivers 30 mg of furosemide over the first hour and then 12.5 mg per hour for the next 4 hours, giving 80 mg over about 5 hours.
Furoscix can be used in adults and in children weighing 43 kg or more.
Do not use the Furoscix On-Body Infusor if you are allergic to medical adhesives.
The Furoscix ReadyFlow contains benzyl alcohol as a preservative.
Lasix ONYU is a pre-programmed infusor.
The infusor contains furosemide.
The infusor is FDA-approved for the treatment of edema in adults with chronic heart failure.
Subcutaneous furosemide is not for use in an emergency.
Subcutaneous furosemide is not for long-term use.
Subcutaneous furosemide should be replaced with oral diuretics as soon as practical.
Pregnancy:
It is not known if furosemide will harm an unborn baby.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.

Furosemide may not be safe to breastfeed while using furosemide.
Ask your doctor about any risk.
Triples: [["Furoscix", "used in", "adults"], ["Furoscix", "used in", "children weighing 43 kg or more"], ["Furoscix On-Body Infusor", "delivers", "30 mg of furosemide over the first hour"], ["Furoscix On-Body Infusor", "delivers", "12.5 mg per hour for the next 4 hours"], ["Furoscix On-Body Infusor", "delivers", "80 mg over about 5 hours"], ["Furoscix On-Body Infusor", "contraindicated in", "patients allergic to medical adhesives"], ["Furoscix ReadyFlow", "contains", "benzyl alcohol as a preservative"], ["Lasix ONYU", "is", "pre-programmed infusor"], ["infusor", "contains", "furosemide"], ["infusor", "fda approved for", "treatment of edema in adults with chronic heart failure"], ["subcutaneous furosemide", "not for use in", "emergency"], ["subcutaneous furosemide", "not for", "long-term use"], ["subcutaneous furosemide", "should be replaced with", "oral diuretics as soon as practical"], ["furosemide", "has pregnancy warning", "not known if it will harm an unborn baby"], ["furosemide", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant"], ["furosemide", "has breastfeeding warning", "may not be safe to breastfeed while using furosemide"], ["furosemide", "has administration instruction", "ask your doctor about any risk"]]
Relations: ["contains", "contraindicated in", "delivers", "fda approved for", "has administration instruction", "has breastfeeding warning", "has pregnancy warning", "is", "not for", "not for use in", "should be replaced with", "used in"]
Answer:

completion:
contains: The subject entity includes or comprises the substance or component specified by the object entity.  
contraindicated in: The subject drug or device should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.  
delivers: The subject device administers or provides the specified dose or amount of the drug over a defined time period.  
fda approved for: The subject entity has been approved by the FDA for the medical indication or use specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: The subject drug requires the specific action or communication with a healthcare provider specified by the object entity.  
has breastfeeding warning: The subject drug may pose a risk to breastfeeding and requires consultation with a healthcare provider as specified by the object entity.  
has pregnancy warning: The subject drug has a warning regarding potential harm to an unborn baby, as specified by the object entity.  
is: The subject entity is identified as or classified as the object entity.  
not for: The subject entity is not intended for the specified use or condition described by the object entity.  
not for use in: The subject entity is not intended for use in the specified situation or condition described by the object entity.  
should be replaced with: The subject entity should be substituted with the specified alternative as soon as practical.  
used in: The subject drug is applicable or prescribed for the specified patient population or condition described by the object entity.
